files.gates: gates/<circuit root id>.json.gz: {lists: {subcircuit id: gate list}}

gate_list_rule: wires 0..inputs-1 are the inputs; each gate appends one wire; -1 = 0, -2 = 1; gates = flat [op, a, b], op 0 AND, 1 XOR, 2 NOT (b = -1); tags[g] indexes tag_scopes = [subcircuit id, parent scope, part index] (preorder, scope 0 = the list's subcircuit)
wiring_rule: parts[i] indexes children (the i-th child call, in order); wiring = [src_part, src_port, dst_part, dst_port, width]: bits src_port+i -> dst_port+i; part -1 = the subcircuit's inputs (as source) / outputs (as destination), -2 = a constant (port = its value; -1 = its value differs between instances), -3 = the subcircuit's own gates (port -1, unnumbered)
gate_lists_also: the tensor-core k-step units and their k-step subcircuit, whatever their size
verification: every gate list evaluated against its circuit (gf2 bit-sliced, 64 random vectors): 2797 checked, 0 differ
wiring_verification: every instance's wiring computed and compared with its type's: 57542 further instances compared, 0 differ beyond the value of a constant input; 8 types have a constant input whose value differs between instances (port -1)
